title.zh: 【法国国民议会财政委员会通过修正案，拟对加密资产兑换稳定币征税】
title.en: 【法国国民议会财政委员会通过修正案，拟对加密资产兑换稳定币征税】

current_state.zh: France's National Assembly Finance Committee approved amendments to the 2027 budget bill that would tax crypto-to-stablecoin conversions as capital gains, permit 10-year loss carryforward, and apply an exit tax on unrealized crypto gains for taxpayers with holdings over roughly €800,000 who move their tax residence abroad.
current_state.en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee approved amendments to the 2027 budget bill that would tax crypto-to-stablecoin conversions as capital gains, permit 10-year loss carryforward, and apply an exit tax on unrealized crypto gains for taxpayers with holdings over roughly €800,000 who move their tax residence abroad.
